capabilities: Sync notes in real time across devices using CRDT merge
Deploy and claim a Cloudflare Worker sync server without a terminal
Pair devices and set up separate vaults via setup links and QR codes
Sync attachments and take daily snapshots with an R2 bucket
Diagnose and troubleshoot sync issues with debug info and reconnect commands
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; R2 setup references an external video, and further operations docs live outside the README.
intentEvidence: If you want a fast, self-deployed, local-first alternative on your own Cloudflare account, welcome to YAOS!
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync options rely on conflicted copies, delayed file sync, or paid managed services, and self-hosted routes usually need terminal and database setup.

relations.evidence: If you want the official, fully managed experience, pay for Obsidian Sync and support the team.
YAOS chooses live Markdown CRDT sync on infrastructure you deploy in your Cloudflare account.
YAOS uses Yjs CRDTs to keep one live vault state moving across devices

summary: Real-time vault sync using Yjs CRDTs over a self-deployed Cloudflare Worker, with optional attachment sync and snapshots via R2.
